references.observed: Actual adult metallic red/orange fantails with short rounded smooth bodies, single dorsal, divided and forked twin tails with spread rounded lobes. Published standard specifies paired remaining fins and body depth approximately 65% of body length. The standard drawings were not treated as photographs.

limitations: Original metallic fantail Carassius auratus visual study based on the inspected BAS adult photographs and published fantail standard. The generic Goldfish alias is retained. This is not a certified show-standard specimen; fine dentition and breeding traits are simplified and movement is artist-tuned.
Small historical slide photographs guide silhouette and colour; the original microtexture is not a scan of the photographed fish.
